# 枯木逢春 1.4.3 / Deadwood Reblooms 1.4.3

- 修复自购房家具目录把原版 `notBedroom` 限制误当成禁售条件，导致四种双人床全部缺失的问题。
- 保留原版孤儿院卧室的限制；自购房可在家具店选择配送房产后购买双人床。
- 核对普通、豪华、异国和藤编双人床的目录显示，以及安装后的床铺记录与同住判定；保留禁售、起配家具和衣柜升级筛选。
- 推荐框架 5.4.2，最低要求仍为 5.4.1；游戏版本 0.5.12.13。已完成逻辑检查与构建，未进行完整实机存档复测。

## English

- Fix all four double beds being excluded from the owned-home catalogue because the native `notBedroom` restriction was treated as a disabled item.
- Preserve the native orphanage bedroom restriction. Select an owned home for delivery at the furniture shop to buy a double bed.
- Check standard, deluxe, exotic and wicker double beds, installed furniture records and bed-sharing eligibility, while retaining disabled-item, starter-item and wardrobe-tier filters.
- Recommended framework: 5.4.2; minimum: 5.4.1; game version: 0.5.12.13. Logic checks and builds passed; a complete in-game save replay was not performed.
